title: Acute Lateral Ankle Sprain Swelling (Clinical Photograph)
author: OdraciRRicardo
caption: Clinical photograph of an acute lateral ankle sprain 30 minutes post-injury showing localized soft-tissue edema over the lateral malleolus.
alt_text: Photograph of a human ankle with acute lateral swelling from a sprain.
clinical_relevance: Demonstrates acute clinical presentation of ankle sprain requiring RICE/immobilization and evaluation for fracture exclusion (CLIFF-047, p.5-6).
